response.reply: Great question, Jess! Dogs are fine to be home for the whole job. We don't spray with an infant in the home, so your 4-month-old would need to be out during the visit. We use professional fume extraction and keep the door closed.
response.reasoning: KB requires flat infant rule and confirms dogs are fine to be home
